title: kbmon --status all's '+N more' counts hidden lines, not the items it cuts, so 'Coord: 4 live claims' shows two and '+5 more'
goal: Where --status all cuts a topic to ALL_LINES lines (mon_status.trimmed), the cut line names what it hides by kind with counts (for coord: claims, drift lines, asks, settings), so a reader can square it with the topic's headline count: on 2026-11-08 'Coord: 4 live claims:' showed two claims and '+5 more', where the five were two claims, drift, asks and settings. The same form serves Sessions and Load. Relates to BG-p4xl2hea (sprints cut to four lines).

run: import re,subprocess,sys;r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py','--status','all','--timeout','60'],capture_output=True,text=True);sys.exit(r.returncode not in (0,1) or bool(re.search(r'\+[0-9]+ more: python3 _tools/kbmon.py --status coord',r.stdout)))
